  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="REGISTRY" name="Registry staff">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>START</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CHECK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>MISSING</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SEARCH</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>MERGE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TRACK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SPLIT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>HAND</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>DISTRIBUTE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>JOIN</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="ASSOCIATE" name="Associate">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>HEARINGS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="START" name="Morning check due" />
    <bpmn:task id="CHECK" name="Check the files to be processed for the hearing" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="MERGE" name="Files checked" />
    <bpmn:task id="TRACK" name="Track the files to the intended location" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="SPLIT" name="Files ready" />
    <bpmn:task id="HAND" name="Hand the files to the Associate" />
    <bpmn:task id="DISTRIBUTE" name="Distribute the Judge's Lawlist to the relevant people" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="JOIN" name="Handover and distribution done" />
    <bpmn:task id="HEARINGS" name="Conduct the directions hearings" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END" name="Directions hearings concluded" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="START" targetRef="CHECK" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="CHECK" targetRef="MISSING" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" name="Yes" sourceRef="MISSING" targetRef="SEARCH" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" name="No" sourceRef="MISSING" targetRef="MERGE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="SEARCH" targetRef="MERGE" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="SPLIT" targetRef="DISTRIBUTE" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" sourceRef="JOIN" targetRef="HEARINGS" />

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
